row.title: Text-form lifting entries settle through the record (US-31-R63)
row.body: revendor on a text-form tenant compared lifting entries (core paths relative to workers/) with vendor-directory keys, so they never settled to a shim. Each entry is now looked up through the record (_record_keys in workers/tools/tenant_sync.py): one the record lists settles to a shim of its vendored file; one whose code reached the core but the record does not list is reported as unsettled and kept, and foundation/tenantsync.py counts it as needs-pr. Evidence: node --test tools/spec-31-vendor.test.mjs from workers/, tests pass (9 of 9).
